mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_bases (id, name, description, color) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{color})
mapper.select: SELECT kb.id, kb.name, kb.description, kb.color, kb.created_at, kb.updated_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM document_knowledge_bases dkb WHERE dkb.knowledge_base_id = kb.id) AS document_count FROM knowledge_bases kb WHERE kb.id = #{id}

SELECT kb.id, kb.name, kb.description, kb.color, kb.created_at, kb.updated_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM document_knowledge_bases dkb WHERE dkb.knowledge_base_id = kb.id) AS document_count FROM knowledge_bases kb ORDER BY kb.created_at ASC
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_bases WHERE name = #{name})
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO document_knowledge_bases (document_id, knowledge_base_id) VALUES
(#{documentId}, #{kbId})
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT kb.id, kb.name, kb.description, kb.color, kb.created_at, kb.updated_at FROM knowledge_bases kb JOIN document_knowledge_bases dkb ON dkb.knowledge_base_id = kb.id WHERE dkb.document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY kb.created_at ASC

SELECT d.id, d.file_name, d.file_type, d.file_size, d.status, d.parse_mode, d.error_message, d.parent_count, d.child_count, d.created_at, d.updated_at FROM documents d JOIN document_knowledge_bases dkb ON dkb.document_id = d.id WHERE dkb.knowledge_base_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
